answer_1.quote: we trained neural text generators on Plum2Text, a Data-to-Text dataset, to solve this particular issue.

answer_2.quote: For the automatic evaluation of the neural models, we use the same set of commonly used metrics as in the GEM benchmark suite. ... BLEU, ROUGE, METEOR ... BertScore ... NLI ... RANK

answer_4.quote: We selected three annotators with legal knowledge to evaluate the generations.
answer_4.guideline: the legal accuracy scale used by the human annotators. The annotators first decide where, between the four regions (completely off-track, similar provision, good provision, and perfection generation) the actual generation sits. Then they remove points for every hallucination and/or omissions encountered.
